question: to the Commission Afroditi Latinopoulou (PfE) Subject:

The increase in the cost of fertilisers and other agricultural inputs is putting serious pressure on the competitiveness and viability of European farms. In May 2026, the Commission presented an action plan to strengthen the availability and affordability of fertilisers, providing for financial support among other things. In view of the above, can the Commission answer the following: 1.
What level of funding, in its view, could be directed to Greece and through which financial tools?
When are the relevant measures expected to be in place and what criteria will be used to distribute the funding among the Member States?
Has it specifically assessed the evolution of the cost of fertiliser and other agricultural inputs in Greece, in relation to income and farm-gate prices?
